verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment isolated from production data is a fair question for an observability SaaS platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no sandbox, staging project, or isolated test environment. Synthetic monitoring (simulating user journeys and API calls) is an adjacent feature for testing monitored applications, not a sandbox for the user's own work against Elastic, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
